description: This file defines the NoteRepository class, which serves as an interface for accessing and manipulating note data through a DAO in an Android application. It provides methods for retrieving all notes, searching notes by a query, and performing CRUD operations asynchronously.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository class that provides access to note data via DAO, encapsulating data operations including retrieval, search, insertion, update, and deletion.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches for notes matching the given query string, returning matching notes as LiveData.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a note by its ID asynchronously.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new note asynchronously and returns the new note's ID.
